detaileddescription.para: The purpose of this function is to illustrate multi-master arbitration lost support in XIicPs driver.

briefdescription.para: Demonstrates multi-master support in interrupt mode.

detaileddescription.para: Design example is to demonstrate multi-master support in interrupt mode. In case of arbitration lost interrupt, the example retries the transfer. The XIicPs_MasterSend() API is used to transmit the data and the XIicPs_MasterRecv() API is used to receive the data. This example tested on ZCU102 board and slave address needs to be changed based on board design
This example can run on zynqmp / versal IIC device as master and Aardvark test hardware used as slave. It sends 18 buffers of data to slave and expects to receive the same data through the IIC.
